title: Show menu search results within 200 ms of a keystroke

fields.summary: As a customer searching the bakery menu, I want matching products to show as I type, so that I do not give up searching.
fields.completion_goal: 1. [metric] state: `/menu/search` with the seeded menu of 40 products, typing a query one character at a time on a mid-range laptop on a local network; expected: the p95 time from a keystroke to the matching products showing is at most 200 ms over 100 keystrokes
fields.measure: p95 keystroke-to-results time from a benchmark test on the seeded menu
fields.scenario: Run the menu-search benchmark against the local app with the seeded menu: it types queries one character at a time, 100 keystrokes in all, and records the time from each keystroke until the matching products show.
fields.environment: local app with the seeded synthetic menu (40 products) on a mid-range laptop; never production
fields.assumptions:
- The seeded menu (40 products) stands in for the real menu's size.
- Measured on a mid-range laptop on a local network (the accepted default).
fields.open_questions: - deferred: whether a CI budget should stop search from getting slow again (the human is not sure it is needed yet)
fields.parked_ideas:
- result caching: cache search results per query (raised by grill; parked)
- loading feedback: a new loading state while results arrive (parked: keep today's)
fields.provenance:
Request: "Make search fast. Customers give up when they search the menu. It belongs under Feature #50 (Menu)."
Vague: "fast" → criteria 1
1. confirmed (perf.target): "Results should show within 200 ms of a keystroke for most people, say p95"; facts: route:/menu/search, code:lib/search.ts
